title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
contentSnippet: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

title: Managing open-weight model risk in enterprise deployments
contentSnippet:
New whitepaper from Microsoft and NVIDIA helps enterprises manage open-weight AI model risks with a shared taxonomy, evaluations, and controls.
The post Managing open-weight model risk in enterprise deployments appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.

title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
contentSnippet: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.
